description: Fresh held-out synthetic source/sink pairs (v2). Written before any scanner ran on them and without reading the Aegis Semgrep rules; do not tune rules against these cases. They measure query behavior on small fixtures, not production-repository accuracy.

from django.db import connection
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.urls import path


def search(request):
    term = request.GET.get("q", "")
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute(f"SELECT id, title FROM articles WHERE title LIKE '%{term}%'")
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
    return JsonResponse({"rows": rows})


urlpatterns = [path("search/", search)]

from django.db import connection
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.urls import path


def search(request):
    term = request.GET.get("q", "")
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("SELECT id, title FROM articles WHERE title LIKE %s", [f"%{term}%"])
        rows = cursor.fetchall()
    return JsonResponse({"rows": rows})


urlpatterns = [path("search/", search)]

import requests
from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)


@app.get("/preview")
def preview():
    target = request.args.get("url", "")
    response = requests.get(target, timeout=5)
    return response.text[:500]
